facts.text: Doñana National Park is a natural reserve in Andalusia, southern Spain, in the provinces of Huelva (most of its territory) and Seville.
facts.title: Doñana National Park

facts.text: It covers 543 km² , of which 135 km² are a protected area.
facts.title: Doñana National Park

facts.text: The park is an area of marshes, shallow streams, and sand dunes in Las Marismas, the delta where the Guadalquivir River flows into the Atlantic Ocean.
facts.title: Doñana National Park

facts.text: It was established as a nature reserve in 1969 when the World Wildlife Fund joined with the Spanish government and purchased a section of marshes to protect it.
facts.title: Doñana National Park

facts.text: The eco-system has been under constant threat by the draining of the marshes, the use of river water to boost agricultural production by irrigating land along the coast, water pollution by upriver mining, and the expansion of tourist facilities.
facts.title: Doñana National Park

facts.text: It is named after wife of the seventh Duke of Medina-Sidonia.
facts.title: Doñana National Park

facts.text: The Retuertas horse, Spanish: Caballo de las Retuertas or Caballo de las Retuertas de Doñana , is a rare breed of horse indigenous to the Andalusia region of Spain.
facts.title: Retuerta horse

facts.text: It is said to closely resemble the ancient Iberian horses that populated Spain before being domesticated.
facts.title: Retuerta horse

facts.title: Kelly Clarkson discography

facts.text: She made her chart debut in September 2002 with the double A-side single "Before Your Love" / "A Moment Like This", which topped the "Billboard" Hot 100 chart in the United States by achieving the biggest jump to number one.
facts.title: Kelly Clarkson discography

facts.text: Her debut album, "Thankful", was released in April 2003 and debuted atop the "Billboard" 200 chart in the United States and was certified in four countries, including a double-platinum certification by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA).
facts.title: Kelly Clarkson discography

facts.text: Its lead single, "Miss Independent", charted in nine countries, reaching number nine on the "Billboard" Hot 100.
facts.title: Kelly Clarkson discography

facts.text: Subsequent singles from the album include "Low" and "The Trouble with Love Is".
facts.title: Kelly Clarkson discography

facts.text: In 2004, Clarkson released her second album, "Breakaway", which incorporated aspects of pop rock.
facts.title: Kelly Clarkson discography

facts.text: "Breakaway" debuted at number three on the "Billboard" 200 and subsequently became her most successful studio album to date, being certified sextuple-platinum in the United States and twelve million worldwide.
facts.title: Kelly Clarkson discography

facts.text: Its first four singles, "Breakaway", "Since U Been Gone", "Behind These Hazel Eyes", and "Because of You", became successful hits worldwide, charting at the top-ten in many countries, and with the latter-most topping the charts in the Netherlands and Switzerland.
facts.title: Kelly Clarkson discography

facts.text: Its final single, "Walk Away", became a top-twenty hit in many countries.
